sources.title: On Sun’s Conjecture concerning Disjoint Cosets
sources.author: Wan-Jie Zhu
sources.version: v1 (14 July 2008 shown by primary page)
sources.read_scope: Abstract/introduction/Theorem1.1 directly inspected; did not re-prove paper or claim full-text priority search.
sources.verified_claim: Theorem1.1 states the arbitrary-group finite-index pairwise-disjoint LEFT-coset gcd conclusion for k=3,4. No cover or distinct-subgroup condition is stated.
sources.relevance: Literal external Sun3/Sun4 interface matches the new written composition. Historical k3/4 result, not current-k7 novelty evidence.

sources.title: On the problem of large gcd for disjoint residue classes
sources.read_scope: Official API abstract only; latest-version history not exposed in reader result.
sources.verified_claim: An asymptotic lower bound for pairwise disjoint integer residue classes: max gcd ≫ k exp(−(2+o(1)) sqrt(log k/loglog k)).
sources.relevance: Integer-residue/asymptotic scope, not the all-group fixed k=7 theorem. Does not resolve the present completeness/priority question.

sources.title: Two Questions on G-harmonic Tuples
sources.author: Murali Menon
sources.read_scope: Current official API abstract; exact X1 theorem/proof was checked in earlier priority notev7, not newly rechecked here. No claim latest-version history was verified.
sources.verified_claim: Abstract claims an A5-harmonic but not Z-harmonic length5 tuple and exclusion of the length5 family studied by Margolis–Schnabel.
sources.relevance: Confirms the related overlap lead remains; local written X1 is a verification replacement, not a newly claimed theorem.

sources.title: The Erdős-Ginzburg-Ziv theorem constant of finite groups
sources.read_scope: Official abstract directly read, no full proof or latest-version-history verification.
sources.verified_claim: E(G) permits reordering selected terms. The abstract proves E(G)≤3|G|/2 for noncyclic groups whose order is not divisible by4.
sources.relevance: Includes D_(2p), p odd, but concerns the UNORDERED constant; it does not prove an original-index-order subword result or discharge our terminal-NF restrictions.

sources.title: Olson’s Conjecture
sources.read_scope: Problem statement and explanatory discussion, directly read. Historical problem record, not current literature certification.
sources.verified_claim: For a group of order n, the conjecture requires n terms chosen with increasing original indices from 2n−1 terms; the text explicitly says reordering is not needed.
sources.relevance: Confirms ordered versus unordered distinction. Does not certify current open status.
